description: Utility functions for converting table options to user report options, handling sorting, filtering, pagination, and default selections in the admin console's system users management interface.

methods.name: convertTableOptionsToUserReportOptions
methods.description: Converts table options to user report options, applying defaults and extracting filter/sort parameters.

methods.name: getSortColumnForOptions
methods.description: Maps a sorting state id to API-compatible sort column name, defaulting to username.

methods.name: getSortDirectionForOptions
methods.description: Converts sorting direction boolean to API-compatible sort direction string, defaulting to ascending.

methods.name: getSortableColumnValueBySortColumn
methods.description: Retrieves the value from a user report row based on the specified sort column.

methods.name: getTeamFilterOption
methods.description: Returns team filter options based on team ID, handling 'All' and 'No Teams' filters.

methods.name: getStatusFilterOption
methods.description: Returns filter options for active or deactivated user status.

methods.name: getPaginationInfo
methods.description: Generates pagination display message based on current page, size, and total users.

methods.name: getDefaultSelectedValueFromList
methods.description: Finds and returns the option matching a given value from a list, or defaults to the first option.

methods.name: getDefaultSelectedTeam
methods.description: Returns default team filter option based on team ID, with labels for 'All' and 'No Teams'.

methods.name: getRoleFilterOption
methods.description: Returns role and guest filter options based on role string.

methods.name: getSearchFilterOption
methods.description: Returns search term filter option if provided.
